summary.text: Brian Biggs is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 70 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A realtor, he previously served on the Randolph County Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Biggs works as a realtor and was elected to the Randolph County Board of Education in 2014, an at-large seat that he left in 2022.
He assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Patricia Hurley.
The General Assembly's website lists Biggs as House Deputy Majority Whip, representing Randolph County.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and chair of the Appropriations, Education and Education - K-12 committees, and he is a member of the Agriculture and Environment, Health, and Transportation committees.
